protocol: v8 one-architecture timing correction; frozen before training and new-test download
hypothesis: At 250 Hz v7 temporal 63 and separable 15 kernels each cover about 0.25 s, whereas EEGNet paper used about 0.5 s at 128 Hz. Test 125/31 timing while retaining SSVEP harmonic head and all other v7 settings.
new_test_rule: S1..S70 excluding historical v2 roles, v5 new test, v6 new train/test, v7 new test; order by SHA256(v8-long-kernel:filename); first five are confirmation
selection: earliest maximum dev subject macro accuracy; no D1/D2 or new test used
comparison: v7 same-seed EEGNetStudent, fixed FBCCA, identical windows and test trials
gate: To claim stable gain over FBCCA: mean new-test gain >= 2pp and at least 4/5 subjects non-negative; otherwise retain FBCCA. D1/D2 descriptive only.
